profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer
profile.summary: Self driven Full Stack Developer seeking to create innovative solutions to modern problems. Experienced in the business and financial technology sector. Always excited to provide quality and value in all products created

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
• Worked in fast pace environment developing full-stack business solutions for large scale financial institutions
• Led small group of developers utilizing Agile/Scrum techniques to provide business users with a friendly interface while tackling complex issues with quality backend design
• Designed, implemented, tested code as well training fellow team members on ideal coding/testing practices with tools such as Java, Angular, SQL
• Developed RESTful API while remaining responsible for software development and code quality
• Assisted in scope definition, planning, estimation and tracking

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, tested, and debugged full stack dashboards for market data applications based on client requirements with tools like Java’s Spring framework and Python’s Django framework.
• Tracked and managed workflow progress through project management systems to accurately frame estimates, as well as organize tasks. 
• Enjoyed working collaboratively with a talented group of people to tackle challenging realtime business problems.

positions.title: IT Service Desk Employee
positions.description:
•	Fix walk-up as well as campus-wide technology issues.
•	Take calls from students/staff to assist and fix computer or account issues.
•	Schedule and go to appointments in order to set up events, fix classroom problems or resolve dorm room issues.
